title: Rosary Session Streak Reliability
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`faith:rosary`), retreat events (`faith:retreat`), attendance logs (`faith:attendance`), fasting journals (`faith:fast`), practice reviews (`faith:ops`).
app: Spiritual-practice telemetry — rosary counters, meditation-retreat schedules, church-attendance logs, and fasting journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=faith:rosary weekday=* streak_kept=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(streak_kept="yes",1,0))) as matched by weekday
| eval the_rosary_streak_held_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - the_rosary_streak_held_pct
description: Measures the percentage of rosary sessions that end with the rosary streak held by weekday.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which weekday are helping or hurting rosary sessions.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `the rosary streak held` on `faith:rosary` events and summarize the hit rate by `weekday`.
visualization: Table of weekday with percentage of rosary sessions ending with the rosary streak held.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how often the rosary streak held happens for each weekday so you can see where rosary sessions go smoothly or get stuck.
